name: ai-desktop-pet
description: AI 桌面宠物 - Electron 前端

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.test:click-through: esbuild electron/window/click-through.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/tests/click-through.test.mjs && esbuild electron/window/xdotool-cursor-source.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/tests/xdotool-cursor-source.test.mjs && node out/tests/click-through.test.mjs && node out/tests/xdotool-cursor-source.test.mjs
scripts.test:launcher: esbuild electron/launcher/desktop-entry.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/tests/desktop-entry.test.mjs && esbuild electron/launcher/application-scan.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/tests/application-scan.test.mjs && esbuild electron/launcher/windows-apps.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/tests/windows-apps.test.mjs && esbuild electron/launcher/program-launch.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/tests/program-launch.test.mjs && node out/tests/desktop-entry.test.mjs && node out/tests/application-scan.test.mjs && node out/tests/windows-apps.test.mjs && node out/tests/program-launch.test.mjs
scripts.dist:linux-deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
